identity.name: Upwash Power Washing
identity.mission: Restore curb appeal with precision and power.

bento_rules.hero: col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl
bento_rules.feature: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 row-span-1 bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all
bento_rules.tall: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 row-span-2 bg-slate-900 text-white p-8 rounded-3xl

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-4 px-8 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-blue-500/30 transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-1 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-400 font-medium py-3 px-6 rounded-full transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-600 font-medium px-4 py-2 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg transition-colors

cards.service: group relative bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:border-blue-100 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden
cards.pricing: bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:ring-2 hover:ring-blue-500 transition-all relative
cards.testimonial: bg-slate-50 p-8 rounded-2xl border border-transparent hover:bg-white hover:border-slate-100 hover:shadow-md transition-all

inputs.base: h-12 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 outline-none transition-all
inputs.label: block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2 ml-1

motion_guidelines.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}

stagger_children.container: variants={{ hidden: { opacity: 0 }, show: { opacity: 1, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1 } } }}
stagger_children.item: variants={{ hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, show: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }}

motion_guidelines.scroll_reveal: whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 50 }} viewport={{ once: true }} transition={{ duration: 0.6 }}

images.alt: Professional power washing service in action
images.fallback_instruction: Use a high-quality gradient or CSS pattern if image fails to load.

universal_guidelines.marketing_rule: Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' layouts. Use asymmetry and overlapping elements.
universal_guidelines.dashboard_rule: Prioritize data density and clarity. Use strict grids.
universal_guidelines.mobile_rule: Touch targets must be 44px+. Images max-h-[60vh].

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Install dependencies: `npm install lucide-react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge @radix-ui/react-slot`
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Create the `Layout` component with the Navbar and Footer. Use the 'Glassmorphism' style for the Navbar.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the `BookingWizard` component using Shadcn UI components (Calendar, Form, Input). Break it into steps: Service Selection -> Date/Time -> Customer Info -> Payment.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the Landing Page using the 'Tetris' grid layout. Use the provided image URLs.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Integrate Stripe Elements using `@stripe/react-stripe-js`. Follow the 'Payment Element' pattern.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Ensure the 'Admin Dashboard' is dense and functional, separate from the marketing style.
